text: As of December 31, 2025, Grab had 12,012 full-time employees [Grab, FY2025, p.117]. This total was broken down by function as General and administrative (1,375), Sales and marketing (785), Operations, support and supermarket retail (6,888), and Research and development (2,964), and includes 865 employees from the Everrise acquisition and 22 from Infermove [Grab, FY2025, p.117]. In addition to full-time staff, Grab also had 1,242 fixed-term contract employees and 3,956 temporary agency workers as of that date [Grab, FY2025, p.117].

answer: As of December 31, 2025, Grab had 12,012 full-time employees [Grab, FY2025, p.117]. This total was broken down by function as General and administrative (1,375), Sales and marketing (785), Operations, support and supermarket retail (6,888), and Research and development (2,964), and includes 865 employees from the Everrise acquisition and 22 from Infermove [Grab, FY2025, p.117]. In addition to full-time staff, Grab also had 1,242 fixed-term contract employees and 3,956 temporary agency workers as of that date [Grab, FY2025, p.117].
